The farm that I work at sells avocados commercially, but has about 40 citrus trees for the land owners and workers. While working at the farm I observed a significant amount of citrus was falling to the ground and rotting instead of making it to peoples mouths. Thus, I proposed and have implemented a donation program to deliver excess citrus to the UCSB Food Bank! Read more about my project and general citrus orchard care below.\newline
